title: Babulus Kanbus store infrastructure
description: Copy the Prospectus pattern (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, infra/lib/prospectus-backend.ts, source-lock.json, infra/scripts/checkout-kanbus.mjs and build-backend.sh) into a Babulus construct called from apps/studio-web/amplify/backend.ts: a private versioned S3 bucket for canonical Kanbus files, a rebuildable DynamoDB catalog, the pinned kanbus-api Rust Lambda, and a Cognito JWT authorizer. Parameterize scope (account 869507387405, namespace) instead of hard-coding. Keep idle cost near zero (no NAT, no provisioned capacity). Depends on the Prospectus sign-in task for the authorizer.
